summary: RCI HOSPITALITY HOLDINGS, INC. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting that Nasdaq notified the company it has regained compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) following the filing of its delayed Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is disclosed; this is a routine compliance update. Watch for continued adherence to Nasdaq listing requirements.
